facts.text: Under the Comet Promise, Texas residents with a family income of $100,000 or less have tuition and fees covered through scholarships, grants, and institutional funding.

sources.title: Comet Promise | University of Texas at Dallas

facts.text: UT Dallas offers a guaranteed tuition plan that locks in tuition rates for four consecutive years to guard against rate increases.

sources.title: Tuition Plans | Bursar Office at UT Dallas
